programme.desc: Crack policeman Hsiang Ming is having a talk with his separated wife when a bullet from hired killer Ah Chui kills the wife, an anti-drug policewoman. Hsiang Ming goes after the killer but is told to keep off by senior officer Lu. In fact, Lu is head of a narcotics ring and lover of Hsiang Ming's ex-wife. She knows his secret, thus Lu hires Ah Chui to kill her. Then Lu sets about to kill every one connected with crime-the go-between and Ah Chui. On his death bed, the go-between tells Hsiang Ming where to find Ah Chui. This Hsiang Ming does. But Lu's men are coming to kill both of them. Hsiang Ming has to fight off the attackers. Hsiang Ming takes Ah Chui to his mother-in-law's house where Ah Chui meets Hsiang Ming's daughter and feels shameful. When Lu's men come, she saves the young girl and an injured Hsiang Ming. As Hsiang Ming's friends fail to stop Lu, Ah Chui takes Hsiang Ming to a secret hide out and nurses him. They become lovers..

programme.title: 金枝玉葉2
programme.desc: With the help of her lover, Sam, Wing impersonated a male image and became a pop singer. But Fong Yim Mui wrecked the relationship when they both had an affair with her..

programme.title: 最佳拍檔之女皇密令
programme.desc: King Kong is commissioned by a man who claims to be Mr. Bond, special agent from the British Secret Service to recover for the Queen precious stones stolen from her crown which are now in Hong Kong. Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters, Mr. Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led by Mr. Bond. Carried out his mission successfully for Mr. Bond, King Kong is summoned by the Governor to assist Collins in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr. Bond's gang.

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: A rainstorm compelled Ling to trespass Lan Po Temple for a night. Ling meets attractive Siu Seen. Being unaware of Lit's murder, he is madly in love with Siu Seen..

programme.title: 三人做世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex and Chu Lai Ngo, played by George Lam and Do Do Cheng, finally get married and live with Chu's daughter Vivian, played by Vivian Chow. Since the owner of the advertising company migrates, Alex starts to take control of the company. However, the company is forced to close down due to the banker goes bankrupt. Besides, Chu and Vivian both join a financial investment company owned by Alex's old classmate ET, acted by Paul Chun. Chu is promoted to be the Assistant of General Manager in a short period of time. Nevertheless, it is a fraud for Chu. Can Alex save his company from closing down and how does Alex help Chu run away from the fraud..

programme.title: 別戀
programme.desc: Young architect Rick treats love as a game. One day, while he was checking out the poster of writer Lok Ching-I's new book, he got hit by a car..

programme.title: 九龍冰室
programme.desc: Ex-convict Dragon works as a waiter after his release from prison. He has no idea that he is now a father, until his six-year-old son greets him 'Dad' upon his release..

programme.title: 富貴再逼人
programme.desc: After he lost his chance of winning easy money in the original film, Bill became an editor for a newspaper and was sent to Canada for a story. What he thought was a chance to re-launch his career turned out to be a reason to get him fired. Just when the family has settled back down in Hong Kong, Bill's wife realized she has won the lottery in Canada..

programme.title: 「戲」遊1995: 一千零一夜之夢中人
programme.desc: Cheung Ka-shing and Man have been friends for many years and both of them are the owner of a garage. Cheung has invented a chip to win the sports car competition and gave the right to use the chip to Wen after the race. Cheung met a lovely girl, Kitty and fell in love with her at first sight. A landslide occurred the day before Kitty moved out of her house, Kitty and Cheung were trapped in the car. The president of a large Japanese Corporation came to Hong Kong to find Cheung. After the group study the function of the chip, they believed that the chip has a very big potential market value. Cheung is hailed as the next-generation empire of the automotive industry. Cheung and Man have started to invest in real estate, stock market and other businesses. Cheung meets Kitty again at a banquet but found that she has married. Cheung accidentally meets a supernatural master who can help Cheung dreaming with Kitty, therefore Cheung has become fascinated the dreaming with Kitty and pai.

programme.title: 洗黑錢
programme.desc: David is a young lawyer who launders money for a gang leader in Chinatown. He is robbed and his assistant got killed when he carries a large sum of cash to Hong Kong. David turns to Waise, his law school buddy, for help. He doesn't realize that it is Waise who sets up the robbery. Petty, Waise's partner in the law firm, finds out that Waise has conducted some illegal activities. Before she could unveil the truth to the police, Petty is murdered. To cover up the truth, Waise finds Mandy, a promising solicitor, as scapegoat of Petty's death. Waise also sends out a gunman to track down Mandy. In a last minute rescue, Mandy is saved by one of her client, Dragon. She always finds the client obnoxious, but now she has to team up with Dragon to fight back and to prove her innocence at the same time..

programme.title: 夜車
programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience..

programme.desc: A detective of the Anti-Narcotics Bureau is pursued for a film he snapped containing evidence of drug-trafficking between a CIA and Hong Kong drug traffickers. Before death, he hands the film over to a Hong Kong immigrant, a pier coolie Luk, who throws it away when the killer arrives. Hong Kong police Madam Yeung assigned to help the local police to investigate the case witnesses Luk killing a killer of the Intelligence Agency but concludes that he is innocent and did it out of defense only. Local detective Donnie and his sidekick Michael Wong are responsible for probing the murder, and when Luk escapes to Hong Kong, Donnie and Yeung immediately to Hong Kong to trace him. Donnie and Michael are also under orders to have him arrested and extradited to the USA. However, Luk and Michael have already been and abducted by the crafty killer..

programme.desc: The invention of a prism - a special brain stimulant, gets King Kong and Inspector into a series of dangerous adventures. The lives of Inspector Ho and her son, Baldy Junior are also threatened by the villains..

programme.title: 雌雄大盜
programme.desc: An armed couple breaks in the venue of the world-renowned jewelry designer Yamamoto's exhibition in Tokyo and takes away the most valuable pieces on display. The robbery ends in bloodshed. Inspector Fujioka's assistant is shot to death at the crime scene. The couple takes the jewelry to Hong Kong and Fujioka follows their trail. Madam Yang of the Hong Kong Police is assigned to help him. However, Yang's superior and uncle intervenes the investigation. Fujioka is tired of such power struggle and decides to act on his own accord..

programme.title: 敗家仔
programme.desc: Young Leong Tsan is nothing but a spoilt brat. He hates books and conventions but dotes on martial arts. His rich father loves him so much that handsome payments are awarded people who manage to lose gracefully to the son. Young Leong comes to think he is the best in Canton. A female impersonator, Yee Tai, rebuffs the amorous advances of one of Leong's friends. Leong comes to even the score, only to be defeated soundly by Yee Tai. Realizing that he is after all not good in kung fu, Leong stays behind with Yee Tai's operatic troupe as a coolie, hoping that Yee Tai would teach him the combat art some day..

programme.title: 我左眼見到鬼
programme.desc: May marries Daniel during holiday and inherits all money after his death. One night she suffers a fatal car accident. Ken comes to save her life and strange things happen..

programme.title: 七年之癢
programme.desc: Living together for 7 years, Raymond has been faithful to Sylvia. But he is eager to having an affair after being teased by his colleagues. On his business trip to Singapore, he is being used by a charming girl, Siu Hung to smuggle some stolen jewelry. Raymond mistakes for love luck yet he fails to have an affair with Siu Hung before she sneaks away with the jewelry. When he returns home, a diamond ring is found in his luggage and Sylvia takes it as her birthday present. Raymond is so involved with Siu Hung that he decides to take Sylvia on a trip to Singapore to bring back the memory. He requests Sylvia to act if they were first met, but it comes an intruder Money who falls in love with Sylvia at first sight..

programme.title: 超級學校霸王
programme.desc: In the year 2043, the notorious villain is about to be put on trial. His killers decide to go back 50 years by the time tunnel, and look for the judge in his youthful age..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 男歌女唱
programme.desc: Chu Wai Tak is a natural born introvert, a white collar worker who suffers from a serious lack of self confidence. Her greatest achievement at work is 'using 10% less toilet paper than yesterday' and saving several more cents. King's self confidence is at its peak as he has crowned himself the King of Karaoke. He becomes exhausted if he does not go to the karaoke box and sing for a few days. King loves to gain attention at the company and has indeed brought a lot of energy to a boring company..

programme.title: 龍在江湖
programme.desc: Cheung Dee, together with his best friends Long Life Chuen and Holy Sand, set up a valet parking counter outside a restaurant owned by a triad society he affiliates with. By accident, Cheung finds out that the son of his triad head, Tai Tze, is fiercely attacked by Song Bo. To save Tai's life, Cheung attacks Song and not only leaves a scar on Song's face, but also puts him in jail for five years which plants a seed of the revenge five years later. Form that moment, the only person that can cheer him up is his best girl friend Ruby. Yet, Cheung has his heart on Sandy, a young solicitor who helped set him free in an assault case. No sooner has their love relationship developed than Cheung's nightmare has begun.....

programme.title: 著牛仔褲的鍾馗
programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them..

programme.title: 少年黃飛鴻之鐵馬騮
programme.desc: The citizens of a small Chinese town suffer from failed crops and corrupt officials. Their salvation comes in the form of a Robin Hood figure, the Iron Monkey, who steals from the rich to give to poor. When martial arts master Wong Kay-ying arrives, his martial arts skills lead local lawmen to suspect that he may be the masked outlaw. Wong's son, Wong Fei-hung, is caught in the line of fire as he fights to clear his name. In the end, Wong and the Iron Monkey must join forces to face the real villain of the piece.

programme.title: 伊波拉病毒
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Kai, a local gangster was caught in bed with his boss's wife, he killed both the boss and his wife. The boss's daughter Lily witnessed the murders and managed to escape afterwards. As the police were looking for him, Kai was forced to disappear... For the last ten years, Kai has worked in a Chinese restaurant in Johannesburg in South Africa after being smuggled into the country. The restaurant owner Brother Kei and his wife Ling take advantage of Kai's situation and treat him badly. One day Kai goes to buy meat from a native tribe, he is unaware of that a terrible epidemic – the Ebola virus has broken out among the tribesmen. During the trip Kai rapes and murders a black girl who is infected with the disease. Kai has no idea he is carrying the disease, his body creates an antibody which means he is a carrier but the disease won't affect him..

programme.desc: Former criminal, Tse-Ho is set free from his incarceration in jail to assist in the investigation of his former crime boss, Lung, who is suspected of running a counterfeit operation. Though initially refusing, he only agrees so he can keep a close eye on his cop brother Kit, who is working undercover to infiltrate Lung's organization. After Lung is framed for the murder of a rival gang leader, he turns to Tse-Ho, who helps him escape to New York where he is joined by Ken, the equally deadly twin brother of the deceased Mark. Returning to Hong Kong to rejoin Tse-Ho and Kit, they soon discover the true mastermind behind the entire operation, and in true John Woo fashion, set out to take him down.

programme.title: 飛鷹計劃
programme.desc: Jackie the Condor is having his adventures, and Baron calls on him for help. Baron gives him an assistant Chinese scholar Ada, to locate and take back the gold hidden by the Nazis.

programme.title: 夜驚魂
programme.desc: A cuckolded husband becomes a cross-dressing night stalker, compelled to strike down any women he sees wearing white fish-net stockings. Leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake, he selects a female disc jockey as his next target..

programme.title: 摩登如來神掌
programme.desc: Two men fall journey into the far-reaches of China, but stumble upon a cave where Princess Wendy, her handmaid Mandy, and evil Tin have been in suspended animation for 800 years..

programme.title: 流氓公僕
programme.desc: Bill and Lee are a pair of old hands working with the Action Squad in the Police Department. They both have their shortcomings. Bill likes to bet a bit to lighten up and Lee likes to flirt with pretty girls. But their little tales do not in anyway interfere with their dedication towards their work. Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. Bill and Lee have to adjust in a hurry how the new inspector likes to handle cases her way..

programme.title: 至尊三十六計之偷天換日
programme.desc: Mindy is a top-notched gambler. During a card game, Mindy swindle millions of dollars, but they are caught. Lau makes a deal with Mindy that Mindy needs to go to prison..

programme.title: 影人映語 -點解「吳式」笑 － 吳君如
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer.

programme.title: 賭后
programme.desc: Nan, a gambling goddess from Mainland China who is smart and has extraordinary martial arts skills. She comes to Hong Kong alone to find her cousin Bao who lives there. Her target: a crooked investor and card shark extraordinaire. When Nan's underhanded opponent proves too much to handle on her own, she enlists the aid of some rather unusual helpers, including an overconfident casino playboy, a disastrously awkward stuntman, and a perky martial arts princess. Pooling their various talents, Nan concocts a crazy scheme to take down her adversary that is destined to go down in gambling history.

programme.title: 暗戰
programme.desc: Andy has only 14 days left in his life. He burglars a Diamond Trading Company and hence arouses the attention of a Police Negotiator, Sean..

programme.title: 影人映語 -葛來FUN多 - 葛民輝
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.desc: Country boy Lee Tong has the knack of getting into trouble with great regularity. But this time, he has to beat it all the way to the city. And the first thing that happens to him in the city is to have his pocket picked. In chasing the thief, Lee meets young girl Fanny and knocks out No.1 ball player King by accident. Fanny and her brother Suen take Lee in. The two boys decide to adopt soccer as their profession. The ball club owned by King employs Lee only because King wants to settle the score with the boy. Lee Tong suffers all kinds of humiliations. Yet he presses on..

programme.desc: An armored car of the Royal Hong Kong Jockey Club transporting several million dollars is robbed by professionals from different countries hired by Michelle. The police put Senior Inspector King to be in charge of the case and Lam, the representative from the insurance company also joins the investigation..

programme.title: 求愛夜驚魂
programme.desc: Lung is a handsome young man. He has gift of the gab and is the best company to keep. Jane is a young talented reporter. She is devoted to her job. Lung and Jane seem to be ideally matched. But Jane, the famous TV reporter, has a lawyer boyfriend. And Lung is a mere taxi driver, just one of Jane's admirers. But Lung is determined to try. He gets to know Jane and gives her hot news tips. He organizes his cabbie friends into a radio news network, informing him all the happenings around the town. This works out at first, but sometimes they are led into ridiculous situation. Jane is slowly distancing herself form Lung. In desperation, Lung calls Jane saying he has the news of the century for her..

When got into acting since childhood, Siu Ho reveals that the encounter with Chang Cheh and Sammo Hung were the benefactors of his acting life and how he went through the mill to make action movies in the ‘80s. In particular, he has recalled his injury and hardship at the set of Hong Kong classic action-comedy ‘Mr. Vampire' that one of the scenes simply had him retaken for eight times! To know about the behind-the-scene of Hong Kong ‘80s action movies, let Siu Ho tell you more in this episode.

programme.desc: Cool and brave, Tong is the most famous big brother. Ha, a loyal follower of Tong, is charged murdering his unfaithful wife's lover. Fortunately, he is saved by Tong's lawyer..

programme.desc: Michael Wong rose to prominence on the big screen in the 80s with his “half Chinese, half foreign' identity and eye-catching appearance, from the early rebellious and unruly big boy to the tough and strong policeman role later. Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor.

programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive.

programme.desc: An army deserter Di Ming Qi, who was chased by vampires in the mountain of Zu. He was rescued by Master Ding Yin and became his pupil. When they were ambushed by the Blood Devil, devil chaser Xiao Ru and his pupil Yi Zhen came to their assistance. With the help of Master Chang Mei, they managed to hold off the Blood Devil but they need to find the Dual Swords to destroy it. Master Ding took the wounded Xiao Ru to Celestial Fort and sought help from the Mistress, but was in turned poisoned by the Blood Devil and he surrendered to the Dark Force. Will Di and Yi Chen find the Dual Swords and destroy the Blood Devil.

programme.title: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..

programme.title: 告別有情天
programme.desc: The film was set in the 1970s, Dai Cheng-wah was a top law student in the University of Hong Kong. He fell in love with an orphan Suk-fun. His father opposed this relationship. The lovers eventually got married and Suk-fun dropped out of school because of pregnancy. Cheng-wah continued his studies and graduated. Under his father's influence, he was only able to work in a shabby law firm. After Suk-fun gave birth to triplets, Cheng-wah had a heavy burden. Finally, Cheng-wah won lawsuit and gained fame. However, Suk-fun suddenly discovered she had terminal illness..

programme.desc: Bau is a poor lawyer who has never won in litigation. He is a righteous guy but his unstable character brings him under disciplinary investigation, during which he meets a beautiful doctor, Cheng. However, since Cheng often deposes against Bau, misunderstanding and conflict grow between the two. On the other hand, Susan, an aerobic dancing instructor, has a deep passion for Bau for a long time and this makes Mo feel jealous and determine to go against him. As Bau and Mo go together, troubles and laughers are stirred up..

programme.title: 與龍共舞
programme.desc: Aaron, a young, successful Chinese businessman, drifts on to a rural island after a scuba accident. Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. But while Aaron enjoys his life of anonymity, Yvonne covets the chance to escape her poverty.

programme.title: 癲佬正傳
programme.desc: Social worker Fun specializes in counseling psychotics. Writer Yip is inspired by his mission and decides to work with him. One day, Fung is accidentally killed by a patient..

programme.desc: Dino Sau is a brilliant motor mechanic, able to supply a Mini Cooper with an engine powered by atomic energy. He falls in love with a beautiful, filthy-rich girl Vivian, but of course she already has a boyfriend. Years later, Dino is rich, and he meets his beloved again. She is now married to Gao Kun. Dino seeks the advice of an evil-minded guru, who implants him with dreams in which he can have his object of desire..

programme.title: 月亮星星太陽
programme.desc: May's from a broken family. Her step father abused her and her mother, and even made her to be a cabaret hostess. Her husband was out but started to cheat on her; Porsche knew her best days were over as a hostess. She had been saving money for going to US to see her daughter. One day her ex-boyfriend came back from US and..

programme.desc: 12 particular nights, from falling in love to drifting apart to a tentative separation and, to the inevitable split, these nocturnal passages encapsulate the entire experience.

programme.desc: In order to enhance a fresh image, the police force selects O and Sammy as 'Sunshine Cops'. But the campaign is not met with the anticipated popularity..

programme.title: 花仔多情
programme.desc: Aran is an honest person. He leads an ordinary life and is quite successful with his business. However, when his girlfriend leaves him, chaos begins. He feels depressed and disheartened. Aran finds his friend Ruddy for comfort. Ruddy's sister Connie has always been interested in Aran so Ruddy and his friend contrive a 'trap' for Aran. Aran is forced to marry Connie. Aran and Connie visit Japan for their honeymoon. It is where Aran learns of the scheme and meets Atsuko who really steals his heart..

programme.title: 賭俠1999
programme.desc: King, the Con Man, is regarded as the successor of God of Gamblers. Dragon opts for gambling and approaches King, hoping to learn gambling tricks from him..

programme.title: 地下情
programme.desc: Billie Yuen and her two friends Liao Yu Ping and Zhao Shu Ling who came from Taiwan, share the same ideal to become famous. The three women met Tony Cheung who is the son of a rice wholesaler at a bar. Tony was madly clung to the indifferent dressing Billie and then they cohabit. The four friends spent a good night at Liao's home, celebrating her birthday. One night, when Liao came home late, Zhao was found being murdered. Liao was filled with great sorrow. The three friends received Sergeant Lan's inquiry individually. Liao felt depressed since her best friend conceals everything. Tony accompanied Liao back home, the sight stroke a chord in her heart and Tony tried hard to comfort her, then they had sex. Liao was pregnant, it shocked Billie, whereas Tony felt difficult to choose. Finally both Liao and Billie left Tony and the three noticed the one they love the most is-themselves.

programme.desc: Hotshot lawyer is hired by a mysterious chemistry factory to dig up dirt on an inconvenient fishery seeking damaging court action. Sidekick Hung and professional crook Yuen swiftly sprint to Chan's aid. Ironically the gang finds their toughness softening in the face of two gorgeous ladies at the fishery. They inadvertently hit a center nerve of the chemical factory when they unmask the hideous facade of a narcotic syndicate.

programme.desc: The Cheng sisters, Li-fang and Li-chiung, leave war-torn Shanghai for Hong Kong. Li-chiung is rescued from robbers by Chien Pei-ling who decides to try out her luck in Hong Kong with the Chengs. They join Uncle and Aunt in Hong Kong. And they get along wonderfully with the daughter Cheng Hsiao-chuan. Li-chiung falls in love with Tony and elopes. That casts the first shadows on the friendships. It's Li-fang's turn to fall in love but both times Pei-ling steals her men. Hsiao-chuan meets Robert. A distraught Li-fang takes out a tutoring job in Macao where she falls in love. Pei-ling loves the same man..

On the eve of the outbreak of war, Kit's past returns to endanger her, and Mark must risk everything for the one true love of his life..

programme.desc: Kelly, suffers from leukemia, encounters a sailor named Michael who comes from the North Sea of Scotland. Love comes and goes until Takeshi comes to her life..

programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy..

programme.desc: The one who solves hermit Ding's chess game will become the grand master of martial arts. A shaolin young monk must solve the complex game to forestall great calamity..

programme.desc: Phillip Wong, a colour-blind dance instructor who is devoted to the Japanese Para Para. He meets Yee, a spoiled rich girl and an attraction begins to form between the two..

programme.title: 富貴列車
programme.desc: During the early reign of Republic of China, Cheng Fong Tin conducted speculative business in the Northeast frontier. Chinese Government sent secret agent Laifu to pursue him. However, Cheng was repeatedly able to escape. Train service between Shanghai and Chengdu was launched. The first train carried many high officials and noble lords including a Japanese envoy with the national treasure. It drew the attention of Shanghai triads colluding with gangsters to plunder the treasure. The train was forced to stop at Hanshui town due to the railroad was exploded by Cheng..

programme.title: 愛情謎語
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends..

programme.title: 「戲」遊1995: 大冒險家
programme.desc: 20 years ago, in the region of Golden Triangle, Wah(aged about 9) and his parents, his god father (Keung) with his daughter (aged about 5) planned to smuggle some valuable items and information into Thailand. Wah's father, Keung and Leung were the closest of friends, just like blood brothers, all 3 of them were C.I.A. agents. Keung left for Thailand before the others to plan the operation. Leung ganged up with some bandits and forced Wah's father to surrender the confidential information. Wah, hidden in the dark, saw his parents being killed. 20 years later, Wah became an officer in the Thai Air Force. He couldn't take his mind off the revenge. Leung became a successful business man. He was in Thailand to launch a major business project. Ignoring Keung's advise, Wah and Roy slipped into Leung's hotel to try to assassinate him..

programme.title: 等待黎明
programme.desc: The story is set against the backdrop of Hong Kong in 1941. Fai, a young man who's trying to scrape up enough money to catch a boat to the U.S. He befriends Kong, who comes from a wealthy family but now works as a coolie working for a successful rice merchant. Kong's childhood friend, Anna who is betrothed to a man by her politically ambitions father. The trio decides to make a run for the boat but on the day of their planned escape, the war breaks out and they are forced to stay behind. Fai signs up to work for the enemy to help Kong and Anna in their next attempt to escape..

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.desc: Four legendary Korean professional baseball players take on a new challenge as coaches of U-10 youth baseball teams. They may be masters of the game, but as coaches, they are complete rookies starting from zero. programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季
programme.desc: Mikey shows a veteran Buffalo’s DC-3, WZS, Buffalo’s very own vintage plane from the Second World War. It is being fitted with a special ‘static’ line, which paratroopers will clip onto for a D- Day reenactment jump. But army inspectors tell Mikey a modern military needs a modern line with a winch system in case they need to retrieve a “hung-up jumper”. Cory and Mikey scramble to build the retrieval line before the inspector comes back to test it. But with their bumbling and fumbling, it doesn’t look like they will make the cut. Meanwhile, Chris Staples and some of Buffalo’s pilots head down to Fullerton, California, to Air Combat USA, where pilots get to experience aerial dogfights in real fighter planes. The pilots do yo-yos, spins and pull Gs to out-maneuver their opponent. First up in the dogfights are newly checked-out co-pilot Sam Storm versus longtime co-pilot David Alexandre. Sam wins the fight due to David’s inability to hold down his breakfast. Next up is cocky co-pilot Chris.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT 第6季第8集 -D-Day
programme.desc: The Buffalo boys gather in Red Deer for Mikey’s D-Day tribute jump. Joe and Sam scout out the designated military drop zone over Abraham Lake in the Rockies only to discover the canyon is too narrow for the DC-3. So Joe cancels the whole thing—it’s too dangerous. Mikey uses Joe’s own philosophy against him: at Buffalo, there’s always a backup plan. Joe flies out to scout a new location for the drop on the lake but hits bad weather. As Joe is about to scrap the trip, twenty paratroopers from the Canadian and American armies arrive for the big jump and are ready to go. They board WZS and Joe takes off to a site he hasn’t scouted, in weather that just keeps getting worse. As they near the drop point, he finally calls it—no jump tonight. They turn back, with all the troops still on board. Mikey’s only hope is a narrow window first thing the next morning—but only if Joe gives the final okay.

programme.title: Billy Goes North 第1季
programme.desc: Billy and his partner Derick remove a nest of snakes from a houseboat, then he responds to a storage facility where some deer-elk hybrids are threatening to injure clients.

programme.title: Billy Goes North 第1季
programme.desc: Billy responds to a construction site where a vicious varmint has the tradespeople running scared. Then Billy and Bea investigate a haunted house to find the source of some strange noises.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. \nWhat becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Although the situation is bleak, there is hope.\nBack at an undisclosed reserve, Matt, KP and Graeme Smith meet another kind of team saving rhinos. From perimeter and ground-based technologies to revolutionary communication and data analysing systems, they are diving into what could be the future of wildlife conservation. Technology seems an obvious solution, but it can’t be the sole strategy, so the team visit a local community who have started a wildlife tourism reserve, which blends employment with the survival of species. It really is a war that is intensifying, and the guys witness the high level of security to protect rhinos against impending incursions at a private game reserve where another baby rhino is roaming freely with his mum. Unfortunately, it’s the exception rather than the rule. Most rhinos struggle to survive. If they survive at all. The clock is ticking, and if these solutions don’t work, they might all be gone by 2025.

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022 第1季
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Making Pandas 第1季
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. \nWhat becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第3季
programme.desc: Bear and Vanessa Hudgens rappel from a helicopter into the high Sierra for a scenic adventure; Bear and Vanessa evade a boulder avalanche, summit a massive dormant volcano, and encounter a rattlesnake; Vanessa talks about her rise to stardom.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Although the situation is bleak, there is hope.\nBack at an undisclosed reserve, Matt, KP and Graeme Smith meet another kind of team saving rhinos. From perimeter and ground-based technologies to revolutionary communication and data analysing systems, they are diving into what could be the future of wildlife conservation. Technology seems an obvious solution, but it can’t be the sole strategy, so the team visit a local community who have started a wildlife tourism reserve, which blends employment with the survival of species. It really is a war that is intensifying, and the guys witness the high level of security to protect rhinos against impending incursions at a private game reserve where another baby rhino is roaming freely with his mum. Unfortunately, it’s the exception rather than the rule. Most rhinos struggle to survive. If they survive at all. The clock is ticking, and if these solutions don’t work, they might all be gone by 2025.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季
programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for kingfish Rick Pollock . They fish the the coast of Newzealand just off a live Volcano, then tragedy strikes…… after the Volcano erupts mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong…. But drama strikes and Mario finds him self in crocodile infested water plucking fish out with his bare hands…. All of these delicious bush treats are prepared of course in a termite oven which Mario makes.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. \nWhat becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.desc: Mike and the crew head to fish over Cornish shipwrecks for whiting; Mike forages for sea vegetables and cooks a feast for the skipper.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季
programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for kingfish Rick Pollock . They fish the the coast of Newzealand just off a live Volcano, then tragedy strikes…… after the Volcano erupts mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong…. But drama strikes and Mario finds him self in crocodile infested water plucking fish out with his bare hands…. All of these delicious bush treats are prepared of course in a termite oven which Mario makes.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness 第2季
programme.sub-title: Giant Jungle Frog, Cheetah Encounter & Alligator Feeding Frenzy
programme.desc: Coyote catches a giant frog, meets a cheetah, wrangles turtles, and feeds hungry alligators.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. \nWhat becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: Save this Rhino 第1季
programme.desc: Although the situation is bleak, there is hope.\nBack at an undisclosed reserve, Matt, KP and Graeme Smith meet another kind of team saving rhinos. From perimeter and ground-based technologies to revolutionary communication and data analysing systems, they are diving into what could be the future of wildlife conservation. Technology seems an obvious solution, but it can’t be the sole strategy, so the team visit a local community who have started a wildlife tourism reserve, which blends employment with the survival of species. It really is a war that is intensifying, and the guys witness the high level of security to protect rhinos against impending incursions at a private game reserve where another baby rhino is roaming freely with his mum. Unfortunately, it’s the exception rather than the rule. Most rhinos struggle to survive. If they survive at all. The clock is ticking, and if these solutions don’t work, they might all be gone by 2025.

programme.title: Save this Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.

programme.title: Malaysian Wildlife 第1季
programme.desc: Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals. The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

飛馳人生熱愛篇
programme.sub-title: 第一集：賽車手張馳衝向懸崖
programme.desc: 2027年的汽車拉力賽中，張馳為了贏林臻東，放棄了提前刹車，結果一不小心就衝向了懸崖邊上。意外後，張馳發現自己回到2022年而且樣貌改變了。張馳突然想起了2022年車隊剛建立的時候，因為車翻了，自己的腿也骨折了，老葉為了維持車隊早就把房子賣掉了，飛馳車隊也就這樣解散了，李小河也離開了，他們連最後的再見也沒有說.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 唐小虎把指導小組調查報告給高啟強，高啟強決定讓指導組在京海市人民面前栽個跟頭。徐忠和紀澤再次找到安欣了解情況，詢問其在京海的工作從哪裡入手調查，安欣告訴許忠他接觸過泥螺村的村支書。村民劉金生反映唐小虎曾帶人上門威脅，並表示見過唐小虎殺人埋屍.

programme.title: 31看世界 - Chill綠世代
programme.desc: 法國東南部，無論是神話般的蔚藍海岸、科西嘉島的原始海灘、豪華滑雪度假村，還是普羅旺斯的薰衣草田和色彩繽紛的小鎮，都是世界聞名。無數的文化歷史遺產、美食和天然資源，讓該區成為法國最具活力的地區之一。面對大規模旅遊、城市化加劇和密集農業等問題，一班有心人想盡辦法，保護這個讓他們感到驕傲的地方。.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 大菇媽想讓菇BB明白他們能飛得很高和追逐夢想，於是嘗試第一次樹葉滑翔。但她很快就飛得太高.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 知名的稻米產地旭川，其實亦是北海道小棠菜產量第一之地。從初春至秋末長期持續出貨，亦是聞名的原因.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第十九集: 馬嘉想盡方法教導心胸外科課堂
programme.desc: 蘇萊曼建議馬嘉可以講得深入淺出一些。馬嘉知道官員和傳媒都會來，唯有與隊員們熬夜趕稿。馬嘉的妻子柳曉弦不想再做有違她志願的電視欄目，決定轉崗。石竹子的外甥趙一聰為了提高孫爽的知名度，也為了把中醫推出去，想好宣傳方法。孰不知來了一大幫人，孫爽也有些頭痛.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 極致新疆
programme.desc: 極致新疆第六集講述從歷史回到當下，看現代新疆的活力，循着張騫“鑿空”西域的足跡，聚焦蓬勃發展的天山北坡經濟帶。烏魯木齊、克拉瑪依等現代城市共同構成了新疆經濟的重要引擎.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：秦川臨危受命查昀城、溪城案
programme.desc: 2009年10月和12月，溪城發生了兩宗槍殺案。武英德、曹忠恕經現場勘察研究後，提出可以確定溪城的兩宗案件和昀城的兩宗案件是系列案，但卻遭到溪城市局副局長顧保雄的反對。2010年10月溪城再次發生槍殺案，秦川受武英德委託，決心偵破昀城、溪城系列案.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十五集：昀城、溪城案另有疑兇
programme.desc: 2011年，秦川到省廳刑偵總隊擔任副總隊長。趙飛提供的新線索顯示在逃犯胡中興有重大作案嫌疑。秦川認為一方面要徹查兇手在溪城逃跑的公交沿線視頻，另一方面亦要到嵐江市胡中興犯案的地方作勘查。經一番研究後，秦川覺得胡中興並不是兇手，決定重新定立偵查方向.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 杏鮑仔需要為菇BB們講解有關蜘蛛的知菇仔的樹屋不夠大存放杏鮑仔的收藏品，所以杏鮑仔走遍菇菇鎮為它們找尋新家。他絕不容許自己不是與它們一同搬走.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 安欣希望高啟蘭和高啟強保持距離，高啟蘭拒絕。安欣告訴徐忠、紀澤，高啟強這次是要破釜沉舟，許忠讓安欣帶他們去舊廠街附近看看。徐忠、紀澤邀請安欣加入指導小組。領導者都不敢在風口浪尖時赴唐家兄弟行賄之約，高啟強不滿二人對自己有所隱瞞.

programme.title: 無所畏懼之永不放棄
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：羅英子拒絕加入卓龯
programme.desc: 邱華找梅大梁詢問當年鑄成案的事情，回去告訴英子她對許卓的懷疑。英子隨即拒絕了許卓加入卓龯做合夥人。許卓眼看拿不住羅英子，便想着手解決陳碩。這時，詺山想找許卓起訴陳碩，許卓開口高價代理費。方麗虹得悉此事後擔心許卓在萬紇案中使壞，勸陳碩退錢但陳碩拒絕.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第二十集: 醫療隊員半夜緊急救援
programme.desc: 石竹子的餐吧有當地人打架，江大喬幫忙解圍。石竹子感激地看著江大喬，江大喬心中有了異樣的感覺，可惜始終沒有表白。一個晚上石竹子和海娜去孤兒院途中遇上車禍，石竹子給江大喬打電話，說出了車禍有好多傷患。江大喬把隊員們全都叫起來，大家緊急趕往醫院救治傷患.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 好味知時節
programme.desc: 涼風至，白露降，人們透過飲食調養迎接秋天。彝族村寨將茭白與臘豬蹄結合，滋養身心，瀘州的白馬雞湯是滋補佳品。高原上，藏族家庭用藏香豬和珍貴血腸慶祝哥哥升學。茭白、白馬雞湯與藏香豬，飲食的答案在自然節律中，共赴美妙生活，時光知味，滋養萬千.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 好味知時節
programme.desc: 在眉山，東坡肘子是佳節必備，紀念文化巨匠蘇軾。城市白領回歸雲南大理田園生活，種植滇紅玫瑰製作月餅，帶來中秋盛宴。龍眼酥作為眉山的傳統糕點，已傳承五代，家人圍坐共品這道充滿家族記憶的美味.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十六集：監控視頻發現疑兇行蹤
programme.desc: 秦川回到溪城，試圖說服顧保雄儘快排除胡中興的干擾，但顧保雄不認同。秦川隨後向省廳申請成立專家組，武英德帶隊前往溪城。民警鄧光榮在一段905公車的視頻上，發現了疑似犯罪嫌疑人（張克寒）的身影，秦川和武英德等人立刻趕往視頻中心，並集中警力排查公交沿線.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十七集：張克寒搶劫未遂逃走
programme.desc: 林鹿分局局長在阜通河周邊貼滿了懸賞通告，張克寒看見立即逃離了該區。面對分局的失誤，秦川帶人來到視頻中的網吧，通過分析上網記錄，找到了張克寒的正面照片，案件偵破終有了進展。2011年6月，張克寒再次持槍在溪城搶劫，但因周邊群眾呼叫而未能得手，急忙逃走.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 適逢相撲菇到鎮外，奀菇菇和阿發覺得自己是菇菇鎮當下最大力的菇菌族。可是秀珍妹和阿毛的力量令他們始料不及.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 杏鮑仔本來很開心毒菇也成為了收藏家，怎料她變得比他還要擅長收集.

programme.title: 嘰哩咕嚕狂想曲
programme.desc: 琪莉發現了她那塊心愛大石背後隱藏的驚人秘密.

programme.title: 嘰哩咕嚕狂想曲
programme.desc: 阿盧看見 Sorry 陷入焦慮，溫柔地伸出援手，幫助她放鬆心情.

programme.title: 飛馳人生熱愛篇
programme.sub-title: 第三集：林臻東來到了2027年比賽的地方
programme.desc: 林臻東回來逆天改命，來到了2027年比賽的地方，他要避免意外的發生。之後，林臻東開車壓到別人的拉車繩，交警過來時，張馳突然感覺到自己的心跳加速，靈魂已不在林臻東的身上，林臻東醒來發現時間與他認知的不同.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第二十集: 醫療隊員半夜緊急救援
programme.desc: 石竹子的餐吧有當地人打架，江大喬幫忙解圍。石竹子感激地看著江大喬，江大喬心中有了異樣的感覺，可惜始終沒有表白。一個晚上石竹子和海娜去孤兒院途中遇上車禍，石竹子給江大喬打電話，說出了車禍有好多傷患。江大喬把隊員們全都叫起來，大家緊急趕往醫院救治傷患.

programme.title: 飛馳人生熱愛篇
programme.sub-title: 第三集：林臻東來到了2027年比賽的地方
programme.desc: 林臻東回來逆天改命，來到了2027年比賽的地方，他要避免意外的發生。之後，林臻東開車壓到別人的拉車繩，交警過來時，張馳突然感覺到自己的心跳加速，靈魂已不在林臻東的身上，林臻東醒來發現時間與他認知的不同.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 安欣將陸鵬帶到專案小組調查，陸鵬發現所裡的人都被帶來調查，只好承認接受了賄賂。指導組發現陸鵬收受的賄賂金額驚人，他背後之人在政法系統裡擔任重要職位，但他口風很緊，從未透露。指導小組發現飯裡都被放了強盛集團的名片，明白高啟強在面對面和指導組宣戰.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 好味知時節
programme.desc: 涼風至，白露降，人們透過飲食調養迎接秋天。彝族村寨將茭白與臘豬蹄結合，滋養身心，瀘州的白馬雞湯是滋補佳品。高原上，藏族家庭用藏香豬和珍貴血腸慶祝哥哥升學。茭白、白馬雞湯與藏香豬，飲食的答案在自然節律中，共赴美妙生活，時光知味，滋養萬千.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 好味知時節
programme.desc: 在眉山，東坡肘子是佳節必備，紀念文化巨匠蘇軾。城市白領回歸雲南大理田園生活，種植滇紅玫瑰製作月餅，帶來中秋盛宴。龍眼酥作為眉山的傳統糕點，已傳承五代，家人圍坐共品這道充滿家族記憶的美味.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 適逢相撲菇到鎮外，奀菇菇和阿發覺得自己是菇菇鎮當下最大力的菇菌族。可是秀珍妹和阿毛的力量令他們始料不及.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 杏鮑仔本來很開心毒菇也成為了收藏家，怎料她變得比他還要擅長收集.

programme.title: 嘰哩咕嚕狂想曲
programme.desc: 琪莉發現了她那塊心愛大石背後隱藏的驚人秘密.

programme.title: 嘰哩咕嚕狂想曲
programme.desc: 阿盧看見 Sorry 陷入焦慮，溫柔地伸出援手，幫助她放鬆心情.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The health impacts of obesity cannot be ignored, and countries around the world are beginning to view "obesity" as a public health issue. In 2024, mainland China issued its first obesity diagnosis and treatment guidelines, clearly categorizing the diagnostic criteria and treatment methods for obesity. The program will highlight the importance of weight loss through the weight loss processes and lifestyles of obese individuals.

programme.title: 談天．說地圖
programme.desc: Speaking of maps, what comes to your mind? A graph with different colors and symbols? Dense red and green lines showing real-time traffic conditions? Or perhaps a satellite image of the townscape?. Or photorealistic view where you can navigate between skyscrapers as if in real life?. 3D Digital Map covering all of Hong Kong have been released for public use in phases. When cities represented on maps transform from flat planes to three-dimensional spaces, how will it change our lives? How are 3D digital maps, rich geospatial information and datasets, produced?. From town planning to construction, from professional to everyday applications, how does 3D Digitals Map build the foundation for smart city advancements of Hong Kong.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
programme.desc: Our city is constantly developing, however green belts and wetlands are also gradually disappearing. Wild animals that survive in the city are facing the threat of losing their habitats. Incidents such as birds crashing into glass curtain walls, mistakenly ingesting plastic, suffocating when nesting with ropes, or falling into sticky mouse traps occur all too often. Kadoorie Farm is Hong Kong’s only wildlife rescue center. How do the veterinarians and rehab officers there save these injured animals? What is the emergency treatment process like? What have they observed? And how do the rescued wild animals struggle to survive.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第十六集: 猝不及防「見家長」
programme.desc: 徐來在靳時川家留宿，遇上了上門看靳的爺爺。爺爺得知兩人關係後，邀請徐到自己家吃飯，還催促二人盡快成婚。徐在靳陪同下到TC公司的加工廠實地調查，孫磊得到江心通知，派秘書到加工廠阻撓。靳為保護徐，被打得奄奄一息。關鍵時刻霍岩宗及時出現，救下兩人.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第十七集: 不想拖累對方
programme.desc: 臧秋發現靳時川腿傷的情況不樂觀，要求他必須留院檢查。徐來為了不讓孫磊逍遙法外，報道了真相。霍岩宗撤回了對TC公司的注資，孫磊腹背受敵，聯繫江心展開報復。靳時川發現自己的腿漸漸失去了知覺，考慮後打算瞞着徐來做手術。靳時川不想拖累徐來，要臧秋幫自己保密.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
演藝盛薈．開放舞台：尋根與突破 向林樂培大師致敬
programme.sub-title: 尋根與突破 向林樂培大師致敬
programme.desc: 「在傳統中尋根，在前衛中找路」是作曲家林樂培畢生的信條，其生平及貢獻已被載入權威的《格羅夫音樂與音樂家辭典》，是同代中國音樂家中的極少數。今集會以五首他創作生涯不同階段的室樂作品為切入點，探討這位大師半世紀以來為中國音樂現代化所走過的道路。音樂會片段由HKU MUSE攝製及提供。. 曲目. 第二號弦樂四重奏《五段錦》(2009). 《李白驪歌兩首》(1964). 《迴紋曲》小提琴二重奏(1959). 《突破 I 》為長笛與大提琴而作(1976). 《兩相歡》(1980，1994修訂).

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：粵港澳大灣區(廣東)國際青年音樂周閉幕音樂會
programme.sub-title: 粵港澳大灣區(廣東)國際青年音樂周閉幕音樂會
programme.desc: 著名指揮哈丁聯同2024粵港澳大灣區國際青年音樂周樂團為音樂周帶來閉幕演出。樂團除了會與小提琴家法蘭和中提琴家格羅斯茲演出莫扎特的交響協奏曲外，還會演出德伏扎克的第九交響曲，更為觀眾呈獻本地作曲家梁皓一的《天穹之志：大灣華章》的香港首演。音樂會片段由香港管弦樂團攝製及提供。. 主辦. 廣東省文化和旅遊廳. 承辦. 廣州交響樂團. 星海音樂廳. 澳門樂團. 深圳交響樂團. 香港管弦樂團. 協辦. 北京國際音樂節藝術基金會.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 上一集《港樂．講樂》Pop Up Show氣氛這麼熱烈，怎可以讓它停？今集繼續有女團IdG Sundae 以及新生唱將范卓賢(Jacky)同大家見面。他們除了會演唱自己作品外，更會分享工作點滴，與現場觀眾互動玩遊戲。大家要繼續留意今集節目！. 主持：. 林泳怡. 歌曲：. -《三尖八角》(范卓賢). -《新新地》(IdG Sundae).

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 醫學．人 2026
programme.sub-title: #7 出生入死 - 范寧醫生
programme.desc: 「生命是否隨著心臟停頓而結束？我認為生命的意義，更在於能否為其他生命帶來改變。」. 擁有多重身份的外科醫生范寧，走出爭分奪秒的手術室，既管「生」亦管「死」。他創辦非牟利組織「醫護行者」及「毋忘愛」，前者推動基層醫療，讓街坊學會互相扶持，提升健康意識；後者推動生死教育，助長者圓滿「在家離世」的心願。「毋忘愛」更為大埔宏福苑死者引入3D打印及遺體修復技術，陪伴死者家屬他走出陰霾。. 「我用醫術治病，但我更希望你學懂如何保存自己的健康，去做想做的事。」. 范寧醫生擁有關懷弱勢的慈悲心，但讀醫時曾萌生退意，究竟誰令他繼續堅持？作為外科醫生，一次遇險讓他失去兩節手指頭，究竟是什麼意外？. 主持：羅鈺文. 嘉賓：范寧醫生（毋忘愛創辦人/醫護行者主席/外科專科醫生.

programme.title: 周末大電影：大隻佬
programme.desc: 看似四肢發達頭腦簡單，以跳脫衣舞維生的大隻佬(劉德華飾)，原來曾是和尚，深藏看穿「因果」的奇能，但他亦背負一個揮之不去的「業」：注定要死於非命。他遇上平凡女警(張柏芝飾)，用「因果」幫助女警追捕殺人犯。愛上大隻佬的女警決定要做一生中最有意義的事，大隻佬亦決定要抗衡因果，改變不可能改變的定律.

programme.title: 大自然零距離 2
programme.sub-title: 第七集 果洲 x 薇黃弄蝶 x 花草
programme.desc: 本著不服輸的精神，王顥霖(Homan)及王韶昀(Mercury)決定鬥多一集，他們前往了果洲群島，挑戰找出傳說中可遇不可求的薇黃弄蝶。究竟他們之中，誰可以率先目睹薇黃弄蝶的風采？蝴蝶專家盧詠鋒(金仔)又會向誰伸出援手？我們拭目以待！. #大自然零距離#薇黃弄蝶#果洲群島#蝴蝶#弄蝶#寄主植物#植物命名.

programme.title: 命懸一生
programme.desc: 回到現實，警方發現倪向東定期匯款給南洋的徐財增並為曹天保購保，而回憶拉回1998年，吳細妹在髮廊遭騷擾時被倪向東與曹小軍解救，三人結識後倪向東對其漸生情愫，卻因幫吳細妹解決髮廊糾紛而卷入黑幫爭鬥，迫使三人踏上逃亡之路；如今孟朝與童浩決定前往南洋調查倪向東的背景.

programme.title: 大港腳闖中超
programme.desc: 李小恆，出生及成長於巴黎，跟隨家人移居香港後加入港會青年隊。2025年受球會山東泰山青睐，登上中超舞台！山東隊曾經四奪中超聯賽冠軍，小恆是怎樣在球隊中爭一席位呢？今集會帶大家了解小恆的訓練實況，以及認識山東泰山這支中超球隊！節目中還訪問了山東隊的傳奇宿茂臻以及年輕國腳謝文能.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 我們的好朋友
programme.desc: 作為全球價值逾三千二百億歐元的市場，沒有任何產業能忽視寵物所蘊藏的巨大潛力。如今，竉物已成為家庭不可或缺的一員；我們對待、呵護牠們的方式，與對待孩子無異，甚至有時更加用心。這股潮流令業界人士欣喜不已。從繁殖者到寵物保姆，乃至時尚、美食，甚至殯葬服務，我們在這些毛茸茸的小生命身上，看見了最美好的一面，卻也窺見了不那麼理想的狀況。. In a market worth more than 6.4 billion euros worldwide, no sector can afford to neglect the enormous potential of pets. Today, our four-legged friends are an integral part of the family. We treat them and pamper them as we do our children. Sometimes even better! A trend that delights professionals.

programme.title: 盛事傳城
programme.desc: 各位吃貨留意：一年一度的美食博覽，8月13至17日在灣仔會展舉行，雲集幾百個展商，一站式網羅環球美食。今年繼續有尊貴美食區，呈獻來自世界各地的酒品、精緻主食、甜點、手工芝士、精品咖啡等。至於「公眾館」，除了每年萬眾期待的1元產品，還有各類特色小食、優惠產品，可以瘋狂試食、掃貨。另外更有「星級廚房」，由名廚即場示範獻技，認真色香味俱全.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第二百七十八集 - 《鳥兒築巢》
programme.desc: 第二百七十八集-《鳥兒築巢》. 【故事時間】《鳥兒築巢》. 鳥兒本來是不懂得築巢，因為沒有鳥巢，導致幼鳥保護不足，鳥蛋破損。於是鳥兒們決定求教築巢專家五彩鳥，當五彩鳥分享築巢技巧時，缺乏耐性的鳥兒們只學了部分技巧，便離開了……. 編導:陸素嫻.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 佩莉特是一位馬戲團的小丑，她在化妝時不慎打破了一面鏡子。佩莉特急需一面新的鏡子，而尋古大師則巧妙地利用這個契機，向她解釋鏡子的原理。他帶著佩莉特展開一段穿越時空的旅程，沿途見證人類自古以來對自我形象的好奇與探索。究竟佩莉特能否在演出前順利化好妝呢.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 當尋古大師準備網購時，驚覺自己將信用卡遺留在報攤。尋古大師前往報攤取回前，他先回到1950年代紐約一間餐廳用餐，該餐廳是歷史上首批能夠以卡付款的場所之一。隨後，尋古大師又到了1970年代的便利店，展示了付款卡的演進歷程。此時的卡片已具備磁條與電子晶片，並搭配四位數密碼，大幅提升安全性。尋古大師接著把自己縮小，潛入自動櫃員機內部，向觀眾解釋現金提取的運作方式。最終，他取回自己的信用卡，並以感應式支付購買報紙.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 一起來發掘我們的強壯寶寶排行榜，包括將擁有地球上最強咬合力的鹹水鱷寶寶，以及能夠攜帶體重三分之一重的獵物的小鷹。在本集中，我們將深入了解這些年幼動物的獨特生理與行為特徵，探討這些特質如何令牠們躋身動物王國中的精英行列.

programme.title: 盛事傳城
programme.desc: 各位吃貨留意：一年一度的美食博覽，8月13至17日在灣仔會展舉行，雲集幾百個展商，一站式網羅環球美食。今年繼續有尊貴美食區，呈獻來自世界各地的酒品、精緻主食、甜點、手工芝士、精品咖啡等。至於「公眾館」，除了每年萬眾期待的1元產品，還有各類特色小食、優惠產品，可以瘋狂試食、掃貨。另外更有「星級廚房」，由名廚即場示範獻技，認真色香味俱全.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Founded by Mrs. Song, Holy Cafe has, for many years, provided job and training opportunities for people with special needs. Every morning, Mrs. Song starts her work together with her daughter Flora, who has autism and mild intellectual disability. Soon after, the rest of the staff arrive — among them, “Big Brother” Luk Wing-kit, who has moderate intellectual disability and has worked at Holy Cafe for many years; Cheung Hoi-ching, who always greets others with a smile despite living with a brain tumor; and several other employees with disabilities. . To Mrs. Song, these workers are more than staff — they are family. The company regularly organizes outings and recreational activities, inviting caregivers to join so that everyone can enjoy meaningful parent-child moments together. . As a single mother, Mrs. Song was inspired to start this social enterprise after struggling to find a job for her daughter after graduation. She created a safe and caring workplace for people with disabilities while also discovering a renewed sense of purpose. Her vision is for Holy Cafe to bring happiness to every community — to use her strength to brighten the lives of those who are often overlooked. . In this episode, our host Jason Chan joins the Holy Cafe team to take on an “impossible mission.” Will they manage to complete the challenge and surprise Mrs. Song and the caregivers with an unexpected joy.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 土木工程拓展署推出建築機械人作檢測工作，於T2主幹路及茶果嶺隧道項目已投入服務.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第十八集: 我們，分手吧
programme.desc: 靳時川等待手術的過程中，故意疏遠徐來。霍岩宗表面和孫磊重新合作，暗地裏卻收購TC公司，徹底讓孫磊出局。霍到醫院發現靳的腿傷情況不樂觀，提醒他不能給徐來幸福就早點離開她。臧秋去參加同學會，被暗諷她失婚喪夫，陸方奇突然出現，自稱是臧的男友，幫她解圍.

programme.title: 照亮你
programme.sub-title: 第十九集: 不要放棄我，好不好
programme.desc: 徐來在雷雨中等待靳時川，卻換來他提出分手。靳不忍徐淋雨，致電霍岩宗帶走她。徐來寄情工作，卻過勞昏倒，被送進醫院，剛巧被靳時川碰到，靳心疼不已。徐來向臧秋追問靳的傷勢，臧看出徐心情鬱悶，帶她到酒吧喝酒。徐帶醉去醫院見靳，問他能不能不要放棄他們的感情.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 土木工程拓展署推出建築機械人作檢測工作，於T2主幹路及茶果嶺隧道項目已投入服務.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈: 粵劇-紅拂女私奔
programme.sub-title: 粵劇 紅拂女私奔 (下集)
programme.desc: 《紅拂女私奔》又名《風塵三俠》，講述中國古代俠義傳奇《虬髯客傳》中三位主要人物：虬髯客、李藥師和紅拂女。劇情描述唐太宗愛將李靖，與紅拂女張出塵相戀，後結識豪俠虬髯客，結拜成「風塵三俠」與李世民交鋒的故事。故事背景設於隋末，各路英雄爭霸。李藥師選擇李世民為發展志向之領，虬髯客則自認為有領導天下之能，而紅拂女之出現便改變一切。他們相互惺惺相惜，結義金蘭。兄弟情、夫妻愛、君臣義之交織成深刻的歷史佳話，長烙後世心中。. 這部粵劇不但保留本土粵劇唱腔及發掘傳統曲牌，當中更為紅拂女添加與眾不同的劍舞。一手舞水袖，一手舞劍，為觀眾帶來一場跌宕起伏的歷史劇情，及難忘的視聽盛宴。. 編劇:謝曉瑩. 主演：李龍、謝曉瑩、阮兆輝、溫玉瑜、郭啟煇、陳紀婷.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台 : 時間終結四重奏
programme.desc: 《時間終結四重奏》是法國作曲家梅湘最為知名的室樂作品，同時也見證着二次大戰殘酷現實的一首重要之作。梅湘在德軍戰俘營被囚禁期間寫下此曲，與同在營中結識的三位演奏家，在漫天烽火的1941年，於戰俘營內為囚友舉行首演。. 《時間終結四重奏》一共有八個樂章，各個樂章以《啟示錄》為靈感，描寫當時一群被德軍擄獲的法國戰俘的悲觀心情。以鋼琴、單簧管、小提琴和大提琴為編制寫成，在四重奏史上並不常見，對演奏者的獨奏能力及重奏默契要求極高。. 本集《演藝盛薈．開放舞台》為觀眾帶來紀念《時間終結四重奏》首演80周年的音樂會，由鋼琴演奏家羅乃新，聯同張文蕊（小提琴）、馮逸山（單簧管）及葉俊禧（大提琴），為大家詮釋這部彌足珍貴的經典名曲，同場亦會世界首演陳錦標博士受梅湘啟發而創作的新作。音樂會片段由港大繆思樂季攝製和提供。. 樂曲包括：. 《雨颯沓》. 《時間終結四重奏》 Quartet for the End of Time. 港大繆思樂季（HKU MUSE），透過舉辦各類具創意特色並富教育元素的音樂會和講座，培養觀眾以及熟悉音樂的聽眾帶來不一樣的聆賞體驗。. Nancy羅乃新，鋼琴演奏家，曾與茱莉亞交響樂團、丹麥電台交響樂團、新加坡交響樂團、香港管弦樂團、香港小交響樂團、香港中樂團等樂團合作及舉行獨奏會。. Kitty張文蕊，現為羅曼四重奏及Contrast小提琴，薩克斯管及鋼琴三重奏之創團成員，香港創樂團聯席樂手。曾參與倫敦交響樂團演出，並曾與香港小交響樂圑，香港城市室樂團等合作獨奏。. Linus馮逸山，香港創樂團單簧管手，曾於上海新音樂周、首爾電子音樂節、香港藝術節及新視野藝術節等演出。. Eric葉俊禧，現於羅曼四重奏及香港小交響樂圑擔任大提琴手。他曾於世界各地不同的室內樂音樂節演出.

programme.title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.sub-title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇製作特輯-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.desc: 「全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮暨主題講座」，由香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會(國安委)主辦。香港電台除了負責直播之外，亦就當中的青少年短劇表演製作特輯。. 同學隨參訪團參觀內地及香港與抗戰相關的地點，深入了解到先輩在抗日戰爭中所展現的偉大抗戰精神，並將體會融入短劇演出中，呈現中國共產黨領導的東江縱隊在抗日戰爭中的英勇事跡，表達對國家安全的理解及愛國情懷。節目旨在提升市民的國家安全意識，並以深入淺出的方式讓市民明白國家安全的重要性、全面性，以及國家安全與全港每一位市民的密切關係.

programme.title: 盛事傳城
programme.desc: 各位吃貨留意：一年一度的美食博覽，8月13至17日在灣仔會展舉行，雲集幾百個展商，一站式網羅環球美食。今年繼續有尊貴美食區，呈獻來自世界各地的酒品、精緻主食、甜點、手工芝士、精品咖啡等。至於「公眾館」，除了每年萬眾期待的1元產品，還有各類特色小食、優惠產品，可以瘋狂試食、掃貨。另外更有「星級廚房」，由名廚即場示範獻技，認真色香味俱全.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 《港樂．講樂》Pop Up Show再次到訪葵芳新都會廣場，今次請來兩位唱得之人–黃博及李佳！同樣從選秀節目脫穎而出，兩位歌手展現出不同的歌唱風格。音色成熟渾厚，情感演繹細膩的李佳，今次帶來新歌《Shake it!》，以節奏輕快的爵士樂風味炒熱全場氣氛。音域廣闊、嗓音清澈空靈的黃博，以親自參與作曲的新歌《靈魂上演》，為樂迷帶來溫柔的療癒服務。. 主持. 林泳怡. 歌曲：. 李佳《Shake it!》. 黄博《靈魂上演.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.desc: 西周至春秋戰國，貴族封土建國，禮樂制度是維持秩序的核心。本集三件文物——七璜聯珠組玉佩、魯國大玉璧、鷹頂金冠飾，由中原到草原，見證貴族如何以器飾展現威儀與責任。組玉佩佩戴於身，舉止必須端莊，否則失禮，是行為規範的具象化；孔子更以玉的溫潤堅韌比喻君子之德，奠定中國玉文化的道德內涵。魯國大玉璧戰國時期的祭祀禮器，其圓形象天，是「蒼璧禮天」傳統的延續，也是權力與通天信念的結合。鷹頂金冠飾屬於北方匈奴貴族，造型彪悍，鑄造技術卻融入中原風格，體現農耕與游牧的雙向學習，是唯一考古出土的胡冠孤品.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 「智慧濕地」 人工智能保育
programme.desc: 在鄉郊保育資助計劃的支持下，世界自然基金會於2022年12月啟動了《智慧濕地1.0》，成功將智能技術融入米埔自然保護區的管理，實現水位、水質和水牛活動的實時監測，增強了對生態關係的理解並改善了濕地管理。. 基於成功經驗，基金會於2024年7月推出《智慧濕地2.0》，透過太陽能供電的紅外線相機和人工智能平台，實時收集數據，自動識別和分析物種，提升保育工作的效率。今集，主持人將走訪米埔自然保護區，帶領觀眾一探米埔濕地的最新科技應用.

programme.title: 命懸一生
programme.desc: 倪向東因車輛涉案躲藏於孫傳海家，而警方在調查保單時得知受益人曹天保並非曹小軍親生，揭開了三人的情感糾葛：當年倪向東與吳細妹相戀，暗戀的曹小軍只能默默守護，後來倪向東沉迷賭博逼迫吳細妹墮胎，心灰意冷的吳細妹在曹小軍的關懷與勸說下，決定生下孩子並由曹小軍共同撫養.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 「智慧濕地」 人工智能保育

programme.title: 周末大電影：相中情書
programme.desc: 出身鄉村的街頭攝影師為了替家人還債，每天在孟買的旅遊景點替遊客拍照。因為年邁的祖母希望能見到他成家立室，他找了一位年輕女客人的照片來充當未婚妻。但祖母突然要到孟買登門造訪，嚇得他措手不及。為令祖母安心，他唯有找出相中女孩，游說她扮演其未婚妻。家境優渥的女孩原本靜待畢業後，接受家人安排的婚事，但她一時衝動下答應了攝影師的請求，令她平平無奇的人生泛起漣漪。兩個來自不同階層的陌生人，因了解而建立了微妙的關係….

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The health impacts of obesity cannot be ignored, and countries around the world are beginning to view "obesity" as a public health issue. In 2024, mainland China issued its first obesity diagnosis and treatment guidelines, clearly categorizing the diagnostic criteria and treatment methods for obesity. The program will highlight the importance of weight loss through the weight loss processes and lifestyles of obese individuals.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 「瞓極都唔精神、體力完全無法恢復」. 「稍微郁吓，諗吓嘢，就即刻好似被抽乾咁，攰到死」. 很多香港人以為生活節奏急促，經常感到疲累是難免的。但有否想過，這並非是普通疲累，而是一種涉及免疫與神經系統失調的複雜疾病—「慢性疲勞綜合症」(或稱肌痛性腦脊髓炎)?其核心病徵是患者無法透過休息緩解的極度疲勞，且持續半年或以上，並伴隨腦霧、肌肉酸痛及勞累後不適。根據過往本地醫學及大學調查，估計約有 6%的香港成年人（20 至 50 歲族群）患有「慢性疲勞綜合症」。本集釐清疲勞真相，協助隱形患者找回身體能量，重奪生活主導權。. 主持：胡志遠醫生、黃婉曼. 嘉賓：TBC.

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《智禦天災》. 極端天氣頻繁來襲，天災隨時降臨。大樹倒塌、山火焚林，人工智能能否在危機出現之前，守護我們？. 張偉健(Andre)因為一宗山火事件受到觸動，決心要在本港開發山火偵測系統，防患於未然，亦因此開展了他的人工智能保育之路。. 本來負責智慧燈柱項目的陳柏坤(Herman)，協助理大教授領導的團隊，開發全港首個樹木智能監測系統，監測樹木健康。. 新科技，又能否重新定義人類與大自然的相處方式.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集: 江大喬助馬嘉走出自責
programme.desc: 柳曉弦與馬嘉通電話，馬嘉為沒有救起孩子感到自責，柳曉弦勸馬嘉想開一些，人力有時根本改變不了多少事，馬嘉不同意，夫妻倆的想法逐漸不同。江大喬曾經也有過馬嘉的這種感覺，多年前因突然而來的戰亂，未能救活他主診的一位非洲女孩，一連幾天都睡不著覺.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 「智慧濕地」 人工智能保育
programme.desc: 在鄉郊保育資助計劃的支持下，世界自然基金會於2022年12月啟動了《智慧濕地1.0》，成功將智能技術融入米埔自然保護區的管理，實現水位、水質和水牛活動的實時監測，增強了對生態關係的理解並改善了濕地管理。. 基於成功經驗，基金會於2024年7月推出《智慧濕地2.0》，透過太陽能供電的紅外線相機和人工智能平台，實時收集數據，自動識別和分析物種，提升保育工作的效率。今集，主持人將走訪米埔自然保護區，帶領觀眾一探米埔濕地的最新科技應用.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 我所看見的風暴
programme.desc: 風暴正變得越來越強烈。但反擊戰已經在雲層之上展開。如今，尖端技術正協助我們以前所未見的方式追蹤最危險的天氣狀況，就閃電、龍捲風和颶風發出警告，保障人們的安全。全球天氣正由令人贊歎的飛行實驗室監察，例如英國每日攜帶四噸科學儀器起飛的飛機。由瑞士製造、飛行高度刷新紀錄的高空無人機亦在觀測天氣。此外，還有尖端的氣象衛星從太空監測，例如美國的革命性衛星，正偵測和追蹤大西洋的颶風，減少這些風暴登陸加勒比海和佛羅里達州等位置所造成的破壞。歐洲亦有自己的秘密武器，就是有史以來最先進的氣象衛星。它們監測危險天氣，及早發現山火，協助救急人員拯救生命。有了衛星、無人機和氣象飛機的保護，我們預測天氣的能力比以往更強。但人類亦嘗試控制天氣，包括利用人工降雨去製造雨水。這是個具爭議性的議題，但世界各地都在進行。氣候變化正令全球天氣變得更具殺傷力。地球的氣象監測武器庫，在保障人類安全的戰爭中扮演不可或缺的角色.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：秦川全力緝拿張克寒
programme.desc: 張克寒為逃避排查，一路翻山越嶺走回了老家昀城也未被警方發現。此時，秦川得知母親去世的消息，上級擔心秦川，提出讓他調職，然而秦川堅持一定要把這案件破獲。秦川與眾人開研判會，推斷疑兇極有可能會在嘉城再作案。2012年1月，槍聲又響了，案件卻發生在鐘城.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：張克寒真實身份被確認
programme.desc: 在鐘城鐵馬山上，張克寒被村民小管碰到，小管立即去報案。秦川帶人去現場，卻讓張克寒再次逃脫，但在他的遺留物品中檢測到了他的DNA生物資訊。隨後，張克寒回到昀城被一男子舉報，警方終得知他的真實身份和姓名。警方來到張克寒家採血，張克寒聽聞後又連夜逃跑了.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 《港樂．講樂》Pop Up Show再次到訪葵芳新都會廣場，今次請來兩位唱得之人–黃博及李佳！同樣從選秀節目脫穎而出，兩位歌手展現出不同的歌唱風格。音色成熟渾厚，情感演繹細膩的李佳，今次帶來新歌《Shake it!》，以節奏輕快的爵士樂風味炒熱全場氣氛。音域廣闊、嗓音清澈空靈的黃博，以親自參與作曲的新歌《靈魂上演》，為樂迷帶來溫柔的療癒服務。. 主持. 林泳怡. 歌曲：. 李佳《Shake it!》. 黄博《靈魂上演.

programme.desc: 我們的菇仔發現了一種超級黏的樹汁並用來作樂，歡樂時光在奀菇菇緊黏在泥濘怪背部的一刻終止.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2
programme.desc: 大家的樹屋都有東西不翼而飛，我們的菇仔要去偵查出罪魁禍首.

programme.title: 嘰哩咕嚕狂想曲
programme.desc: 琪莉試圖讓阿盧想起他，沒想到事與願違，情況完全不符預期.

programme.title: 嘰哩咕嚕狂想曲
programme.desc: 阿盧在夢中領悟到，即使身處最奇異的處境，依然能夠尋獲快樂.

programme.title: 飛馳人生熱愛篇
programme.sub-title: 第四集：林臻東回到車隊解釋
programme.desc: 林臻東出去後發現自己的時間消失了一天，他回到車隊趕緊給葉功解釋昨天是林臻東本人而不是自己，大家也沒明白是甚麼情況，林臻東表示張馳會因為邀請賽而摔斷腿，但是現在大家都不願意相信林臻東.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 根據環保署的研究，海洋垃圾與人類活動息息相關，偏遠海灣因水流及地理因素，往往成為垃圾積聚的黑點，發泡膠碎、漁網和膠樽隨處可見。環保署推出「組織海岸清潔活動八部曲」，讓市民可以自行組織清潔活動，並獲得垃圾袋、棉手套等物資支援.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 根據環保署的研究，海洋垃圾與人類活動息息相關，偏遠海灣因水流及地理因素，往往成為垃圾積聚的黑點，發泡膠碎、漁網和膠樽隨處可見。環保署推出「組織海岸清潔活動八部曲」，讓市民可以自行組織清潔活動，並獲得垃圾袋、棉手套等物資支援.

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《AI 動物傳心術》. 人類一直渴望理解動物在想甚麼。隨著人工智能的發展，我們或許能更貼近牠們的世界。大熊貓可可居住在海洋公園近兩年，資訊科技專家石音洲透過 AI 追蹤牠的日常舉動，希望更早讀懂牠的需要。Eugene 與 Oscar兩姊弟曾因毛孩離世而留下遺憾，決心研發貓狗專用 AI 獸醫，從「便便」中找出健康線索。科技未必能完全解讀動物心聲，但至少讓我們更懂得愛與陪伴.

programme.title: 歡迎來到麥樂村
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集: 江大喬助馬嘉走出自責
programme.desc: 柳曉弦與馬嘉通電話，馬嘉為沒有救起孩子感到自責，柳曉弦勸馬嘉想開一些，人力有時根本改變不了多少事，馬嘉不同意，夫妻倆的想法逐漸不同。江大喬曾經也有過馬嘉的這種感覺，多年前因突然而來的戰亂，未能救活他主診的一位非洲女孩，一連幾天都睡不著覺.

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《AI 動物讀心術》. 大熊貓一天24小時的生活，是否只是吃飽睡，睡飽再吃？海洋公園的資訊科技專家和研究人員決定一探究竟！他們透過24小時攝影鏡頭捕捉大熊貓的一舉一動，然後用 AI 解碼牠們的動作，了解牠們喜歡在哪個區域停留、哪一款玩具最吸引牠們，以及甚麼時間最活躍。負責設計程式的資訊科技專家石音洲，更被同事對動物的熱誠所感染，希望 AI 能幫到更多有心的護理員，下一步更計劃將這項技術應用在海豚的研究上。. 另一邊廂，Eugene 與 Oscar 兩姊弟視小動物為家人。他們曾經因為未能及早察覺愛犬的病痛而抱憾，決定化遺憾為動力，研發出貓狗專用的 AI 健康監測平台——教大家如何從日常的「便便」中看出端倪，及早找出小動物的健康警號！. 科技未必能讓我們真的變成「動物傳心師」，但至少讓我們更貼近牠們的世界、更懂得愛與陪伴.

programme.title: 飛馳人生熱愛篇
programme.sub-title: 第四集：林臻東回到車隊解釋
programme.desc: 林臻東出去後發現自己的時間消失了一天，他回到車隊趕緊給葉功解釋昨天是林臻東本人而不是自己，大家也沒明白是甚麼情況。林臻東表示，張馳會因為邀請賽而摔斷腿，但是大家都不願意相信林臻東的說話.

programme.title: 狂飆
programme.desc: 石磊在唐小龍的威脅下，不得已賣了祖宅還錢。安欣帶著專案小組去探望石磊，在勸說下，石磊和專案小組合作。專案組向徐忠匯報，安欣認為隊伍有人在給唐小龍通風報信。安欣設局帶張彪及刑警隊成員突擊唐小龍的賣淫窩點，稱其今天會來收賬，張彪果不其然給唐小龍通風報信.

programme.title: 無所畏懼之永不放棄
programme.sub-title: 第三十集：羅英子支持陳碩決定
programme.desc: 英子去找許卓協商又找方麗虹幫忙陳碩的事皆遭拒，於是決定邀請陳碩加入瑛華但陳碩拒絕了。方麗虹擔心英子和邱華會因此事在萬紇案上發難，立即找來許卓通報情況。許卓把事情告知鼎薪劉總並取得劉總同意暫不報警，但英子認為應該報警，更向陳碩表示支持他和詺山對抗到底.

programme.sub-title: 第二十二集: 婦產科醫生蘇心因家事要急回國
programme.desc: 婦產科醫生蘇心八歲的女兒摔傷了腿，奶奶認為蘇心沒有盡到母親的責任還怪她沒帶好孩子，一氣之下回了老家，蘇心的女兒無人照看，急得蘇心要回國。柳曉弦的師兄李默，想請柳曉弦去香港上班，繼續她做理想的民生節目，原來李默一直以來對柳曉弦都有意思，哪怕她已婚.

programme.desc: 2012年8月，昀城松樹坪中安銀行發生槍擊案，秦川迅速判斷出是張克寒所為，並實施佈防追捕。張克寒逃竄過程中又槍殺了鐵警，警方四處張貼通緝令，隨即在大順商場發現他的行蹤。秦川決定以松樹坪附近的墓地作為佈控點，分三線佈防，務求在張克寒再次作案前抓捕他.

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《AI 動物讀心術》. 大熊貓一天24小時的生活，是否只是吃飽睡，睡飽再吃？海洋公園的資訊科技專家和研究人員決定一探究竟！他們透過24小時攝影鏡頭捕捉大熊貓的一舉一動，然後用 AI 解碼牠們的動作，了解牠們喜歡在哪個區域停留、哪一款玩具最吸引牠們，以及甚麼時間最活躍。負責設計程式的資訊科技專家石音洲，更被同事對動物的熱誠所感染，希望 AI 能幫到更多有心的護理員，下一步更計劃將這項技術應用在海豚的研究上。. 另一邊廂，Eugene 與 Oscar 兩姊弟視小動物為家人。他們曾經因為未能及早察覺愛犬的病痛而抱憾，決定化遺憾為動力，研發出貓狗專用的 AI 健康監測平台——教大家如何從日常的「便便」中看出端倪，及早找出小動物的健康警號！. 科技未必能讓我們真的變成「動物傳心師」，但至少讓我們更貼近牠們的世界、更懂得愛與陪伴.

programme.title: 談天．說地圖
programme.desc: Speaking of maps, what comes to your mind? A graph with different colors and symbols? Dense red and green lines showing real-time traffic conditions? Or perhaps a satellite image of the townscape?. Or photorealistic view where you can navigate between skyscrapers as if in real life?. 3D Digital Map covering all of Hong Kong have been released for public use in phases. When cities represented on maps transform from flat planes to three-dimensional spaces, how will it change our lives? How are 3D digital maps, rich geospatial information and datasets, produced?. From town planning to construction, from professional to everyday applications, how does 3D Digitals Map build the foundation for smart city advancements of Hong Kong.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: Guardians of the Mai Po Wetland
programme.desc: The Mai Po Inner Deep Bay Wetland is classified as a "Wetland of International Importance" and is the only wetland reserve in the city. It has extremely high ecological value. Several experts were invited to guide the host on how to become a conservationist and learn how to manage the Mai Po Wetland.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯1970年出土於陝西西安何家村窖藏，屬唐代文物。杯體以罕見瑪瑙製成，呈獸首造型，形似橫放的牛角或平臥的羚羊，嘴部鑲金塞，紋理自然流暢。此杯造型與西亞、地中海的「來通」酒具極度相似，可能為中亞或西亞進貢之物，或由外來工匠於長安製作。它既是唐代宮廷的實用酒器，亦見證絲綢之路上的文明交流，反映唐朝開放包容、融匯多元文化的恢弘氣度.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 蓮鶴方壺1923年出土於河南新鄭李家樓，是春秋時期的鄭公大墓。方壺高117厘米，重64公斤，壺身呈橢長方形，飾有蟠龍紋；壺頂為十瓣雙層蓮瓣，中央立有一隻展翅欲飛的仙鶴，造型靈動，融合商周青銅器的獰厲威嚴與楚文化的寫實浪漫。此壺以分鑄焊接之術熔鑄周禮、楚風與中原文化於一身，是春秋時期多元文化交融的縮影，亦是青銅鑄造技藝的典範.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 七孔骨笛1987年出土於河南賈湖遺址，距今約八千餘年，以丹頂鶴尺骨製成，長22.7厘米，七孔，音域橫跨兩個八度，半音階齊全，是至今中國發現最早、保存最完整的吹管樂器。骨笛可演奏五聲調式及西域樂曲，反映新石器時代已具備七聲音階觀念。賈湖人在無金屬工具下，憑反覆度量打磨，精準開孔調音，展現非凡智慧。此笛既是狩獵誘具，亦是祭祀神器，見證中華禮樂文明的曙光.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 青瓷釉下彩羽人纹盤口壺
programme.desc: 青瓷釉下彩羽人紋盤口壺出土於三國東吳時期，高32.1厘米，壺身飾有佛像、雙首連體鳥等紋飾，以褐彩勾勒，上覆青黃色釉，是迄今所見最早使用釉下彩繪裝飾瓷器的典型之一。此壺將道教羽化、佛教輪迴等元素融於一體，反映古人對飛升成仙的嚮往。其精湛工藝為後世青花瓷、釉裏紅等瓷器品類奠定基礎，改寫了中國陶瓷史.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 鑲嵌綠松石獸面紋銅牌飾
programme.desc: 鑲嵌綠松石獸面紋銅牌飾1984年出土於河南省偃師縣二里頭遺址，屬於夏朝中晚期文物，長16.5厘米，闊11厘米，主體以青銅鑄造，牌飾上鑲有五百餘片綠松石，拼合嚴密，歷數千年無一鬆脫。牌面獸目圓睜，造型威嚴神秘，展現早期神靈崇拜意象。此器集鑄造與鑲嵌工藝於一身，反映二里頭時期高超的青銅與玉石複合加工技術，是夏朝文明及中原與周邊文化交流的重要見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 青花蕭何月下追韓信圖梅瓶
programme.desc: 青花蕭何月下追韓信圖梅瓶為元末明初罕見的青花瓷珍品，高44.1厘米，其胎質潔白細膩、白釉潔淨瑩潤、青料濃艷優雅，是元代青花瓷的巔峰之作。瓶身繪畫的是秦末「楚漢相爭」的故事，人物卻穿着宋代服飾，元代雜劇的演繹，令歷史與藝術在梅瓶上交融。此瓶融合草原民族的鈷藍之美、波斯陶器的白地藍彩，經由絲路傳入景德鎮，在1300度高溫中燒製而成，見證中外文明交流的輝煌歷史.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.sub-title: 琺華彩貼金應龍紋梅瓶
programme.desc: 琺華彩貼金應龍紋梅瓶出土於南海明代深海裏的沉船，屬明正德年間景德鎮民窯精品。瓶身紋飾精妙，集瀝粉、鏤空、貼金、彩繪等工藝於一身，展現明代中期的高超製瓷水準。此瓶是當時為海外市場高端訂製的產品，見證「隆慶開關」政令之後，明代海外貿易蓬勃發展，亦是海上絲綢之路文明交流的重要物證，現藏於中國（海南）南海博物館.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 馬王堆一號墓為西漢長沙國丞相利蒼及其夫人辛追之墓，建於漢初、約公元前163年。其「井」字形木槨採用「一槨四棺」結構，規模宏大，是迄今出土最大最完整的漢代井槨實物。四重套棺所用之顏色及繪畫的圖像，神秘而浪漫，具典型楚文化風格。木槨分層象徵天界、人間、地界，槨室佈置如墓主生前居所，東、南、西三面廂室裝滿陪葬品，體現「事死如事生」觀念。辛追夫人屍身及大量陪葬品因密封保存完好，是研究漢代文化的重要實證.

programme.title: 十八好時光
programme.desc: 十八好時光 8月13日.

programme.title: 家國萬里
programme.desc: Set against the deserts of Xinjiang, this episode uncovers ancient and modern innovations in technology, culture, and governance that continue to inspire progress.

programme.title: 證義搜查線之騙局拼圖
programme.desc: The boss of a listed medical beauty company, Rosita Chiang from "Beauty In The Making," raised funds through a new stock allocation method to purchase "On Yin Pharmaceutical," which claimed to have great potential. However, Hong Kong Securities and Futures commission suspected that the latter was just a business-obscure shell company. Investigator Crystal encountered a minor accident and got injured while conducting an on-site inspection of the factory alone. However, her supervisor, Tony, reiterated his disagreement with her overly aggressive approach and revealed his own investigation: Rosita's offer to purchase the company from the person in charge of "On Yin". Mak Kong, was a pretext for stock allocation. Prior to this, Chiang had manipulated "dummy accounts" to boost the stock price and create a false positive image. However, all the accounts were located offshore, making it difficult to gather evidence. Determined, Crystal held on and continued to search through a large amount of data, finally finding a loophole and successfully proving that Rosita Chiang directly caused market misconduct, leaving her speechless despite her previous arrogance. In fact, Tony and Crystal have pre-existing values based on their life experiences. Crystal had a close friend who was deceived and suffered financial and emotional harm, leading Crystal to harbor deep resentment towards scammers. On the other hand, Tony has sailed through many ups and downs in life and has come to understand that everything has its causes and consequences, and there is no need to be overly attached. Their differences in values have become more apparent in their investigative work. How can they successfully reconcile their differences.

programme.title: 香港故事-從獅子山遠眺神州大地
programme.desc: 中國古代皇帝貴族一般會學什麼?九歲的宋哲宗遇上理學大師程顥，又受到什麼的教導呢？大理，位於中國西南的一個尊崇佛教的古國，為何他們的國王，有不少都選擇為僧呢?全盛時的大理，有大大小小的佛廟數以千計，所以大理有妙香古國之稱。佛教思想不單在大理盛行，亦是中原的重要精神支柱，從觀賞宏偉龍門石窟，可見佛教在北魏，以至唐代是十分受皇家推崇。今天，大理國已成歷史煙雲，但在大理古城西面的諾鄧古村，仍保留著古代鹽井、鹽馬古道，承傳著古老的製鹽方法，是現存少有的原貌古村落，村內處處滲透著古樸的大理遺風。. 小說《西遊記》形容火焰山年年噴火，是孫悟空踢翻八卦爐，餘火掉到地上，才形成火焰山。真實的火焰山是在新疆吐魯番地區，古稱西域。是什麼地理因素，使這裏有高溫而乾旱的天氣呢？幸好地下水沿豐富，適合葡萄生長。由公元前五至六年開始，在塔里木盆地相繼出現了30多個大大小小的陸洲國家，史稱「西域三十六國」。其中較有名的是大宛及烏孫。漢朝時曾派遣張騫出使西域，這個出使又是什麼原因呢？. 主持：文恩澄. 嘉賓:朱銘堅博士(香港大學中文學院助理教授).

programme.title: 悅讀憲法 英文版
programme.sub-title: People’s Well-being — Connection between the Constitution and Society
programme.desc: Safeguarding people’s well-being is the core spirit of the Constitution. Article 45 of the Constitution stipulates that citizens shall have the right to material assistance from the state and society when they are aged, ill or have lost the capacity to work. Focusing on “society and people’s livelihood”, this episode examines how the Constitution underpins a comprehensive social security system that addresses the needs of the elderly. In recent years, many Hong Kong seniors have chosen to retire in the Greater Bay Area. Through a visit to a residential care home for the elderly in Foshan, the episode provides insights into the retirement life of Hong Kong seniors, and explores how they can enjoy their golden years with institutional safeguards and community care, highlighting the Constitution’s core values of putting people first and safeguarding their livelihood.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 「智慧濕地」 人工智能保育
programme.desc: 在鄉郊保育資助計劃的支持下，世界自然基金會於2022年12月啟動了《智慧濕地1.0》，成功將智能技術融入米埔自然保護區的管理，實現水位、水質和水牛活動的實時監測，增強了對生態關係的理解並改善了濕地管理。. 基於成功經驗，基金會於2024年7月推出《智慧濕地2.0》，透過太陽能供電的紅外線相機和人工智能平台，實時收集數據，自動識別和分析物種，提升保育工作的效率。今集，主持人將走訪米埔自然保護區，帶領觀眾一探米埔濕地的最新科技應用.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 -- 唐代建築篇 (英文版)
programme.desc: The two hosts, having traveled from Hong Kong, will venture beyond Nara to explore Kyoto and Osaka in this episode. . Kyoto, with its ancient charm, is well-known to many in Hong Kong. Since the hosts aim to provide a unique and in-depth experience, the places they visit will be different from the usual tourist spots. They will take viewers away from the hustle and bustle to the outskirts of Kyoto, starting with a visit to a chestnut orchard to pick chestnuts. Next, they'll head to the famous Uji tea area, where they will participate in tea picking and a soba noodle-making experience. . For cultural experiences, they will take part in a sumi ink-making workshop, highlighting the influence of Chinese culture. Interestingly, the works of famous Tang dynasty poets like Li Bai and Du Fu were highly regarded by the Japanese. . Traveling is not just about sightseeing but also about enjoying food and shopping. The hosts will visit a 120-year-old shop that originally specialized in stage makeup products for geishas. They will also discover that the face oil paper we commonly use today was invented by this very company. . As a nation adept at absorbing foreign cultures, Japan has embraced not only Chinese culture but also jazz music, which has a history of over a century in the country. Although the younger generation now shows less enthusiasm for jazz than previous generations, the music-loving hosts will still visit a jazz live house to experience the lingering charm of jazz.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 根據環保署的研究，海洋垃圾與人類活動息息相關，偏遠海灣因水流及地理因素，往往成為垃圾積聚的黑點，發泡膠碎、漁網和膠樽隨處可見。環保署推出「組織海岸清潔活動八部曲」，讓市民可以自行組織清潔活動，並獲得垃圾袋、棉手套等物資支援.

programme.title: 中華知識王
programme.sub-title: 第五集 - 黑龍江省X杭州西湖X火星1號基地？｜體育名嘴鍾志光跨界點評｜人民幣風景藏玄機？｜U型鐵器文物竟讓歐洲震驚？
programme.desc: 今集知識小王子為了拜師學藝，準備了一份束脩、一件青衿及一套笈囊？而三隊參賽隊伍則早做足準備迎戰，分別是跨越不同年齡層的「書香世代隊」、由老師學生組成的「龍的傳人隊」及鑽研古今典藉的「博古通今隊」，誰能從也文也武的嘉賓評判鍾志光手上奪得「中華知識王」？平日雖則多評論體育賽事，但要從中國文學、歷史、文化點評參賽者也絕對難不到他。相反，到底各個朝化的歷史人物、各省各地的文化習俗、乃至人民幣上的風景圖案會否考倒參賽者？而第二回合「萬水千山識中華」會帶大家到黑龍江省、杭州西湖及青海冷湖的實景體驗基地「火星1號基地」，當中會有甚麼難題？而最大的難題非第三回合「中國黑科技」莫屬！一雙U型鐵器如何考證中華文化歷史上的創新性？更有學者說這發明在歷史上產生巨大的催化影響，甚至影響中世紀歐洲？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌揚. 嘉賓評判：鍾志光(香港教育大學榮譽院士). 參賽隊伍：書香世代隊、博古通今隊、龍的傳人隊. 香港電台與政制及內地事務局聯合製作，5月31日星期六晚上8時播出.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂 (英文版)
programme.desc: Extraordinary Lao Cuisine takes audiences into the rarely seen world of Lao dining in Hong Kong to explore the unique flavors of this Golden Triangle hub. Host Andy Dark personally samples “Luang Prabang” specialties, such as “Sinatal Ki” Chicken, to uncover the secrets of Lao culinary traditions. The episode highlights four-color glutinous rice and introduces the medicinal culinary culture of natural dyeing using sappan wood and pale butterfly bush flowers. . The proprietress also personally demonstrates how to cook "Lap Khao" (Lao crispy fried rice) and teaches the traditional three-finger technique for eating sticky rice by hand, showcasing the rich, layered sensations of Lao cuisine: crispy, sour, spicy, and sweet. The program also documents the restaurant's transition into a street-stall and takeaway operation. Though the dining room lights may dim, the enticing aroma of the food lingers on—allowing the flavors of Laos to permeate the daily fabric of the city and inspiring more people to discover this mysterious cuisine.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
照顧者們
programme.desc: 麥婆婆與胡伯無兒無女，一直只有二人共同生活，相濡以沫。直至大坑西拆遷消息來臨，二人為尋找新居奔波煩腦之際，麥婆婆突然在街上暈倒。. 年近九十歲胡伯獨力尋找新居、搬家，更要照顧跌傷腳後無力自理的麥婆婆，二人漸明白長此下去不是辦法。胡伯找到環境合適的安老院，麥婆婆掙扎苦思半年後，終下定決心到院舍入住。胡伯堅持每天探望，麥婆婆日漸適應院舍生活，同時接受物理治療等院舍服務，安老院亦不時舉辦護老新產品推廣活動，發現軟餐發展亦令老年人生活重拾姿彩。. 二人重新找到生活等節奏。大坑西重建在即，二人重遊勾起半生回憶，對將來亦重燃寄望.

programme.sub-title: Diary of birdwatching at Tai Tong
programme.desc: Tai Lam Country Park is located in the western New Territories, spanning the Tsuen Wan to Tuen Mun area. It is the second largest country park in Hong Kong. There are seven reservoirs at the entrance of the park. Starting from Tsuen Kam Au, you can walk on Sections 9 and 10 of the MacLehose Trail. Along the way, you can admire Tai Lam Chung Reservoir and Ho Pui Reservoir, the largest of them all. After finishing the walk, you can go through Tuen Mun Leave the golden beach. . Come to a bird watching instructor and learn to watch forest birds.

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.sub-title: 李展鑾 : 戲劇 / 夢 / 人生
programme.desc: 李展鑾，劇團總監，舞台劇狂熱份子，夢想是一直做喜歡的戲劇，當自己人生的編劇、導演和演員。他由中學時代開始投入戲劇世界，並在大學延續其對戲劇的熱情，無論是擔任主力，或是當製作團隊的小崗位，他均樂在其中。畢業後，為了平衡追夢與生活，他選擇利用工餘時間從事戲劇行業，其後更創立劇團，擔任班主，繼續創作。. 這一集，我們一起走進李展鑾的戲劇世界。面對現實環境的限制、家庭崗位的轉變，他如何堅持初衷？又怎樣走進校園，將夢想結合教育，啟發新一代追尋戲劇夢.

programme.title: 橫素全中國
programme.desc: 今集開始展開陝西之旅，尋找一種當地傳統的手工掛麵，在一個以肉食為主嘅地域，嘉年可以找到甚麼素食選擇？主持人先暢遊陝西榆林，遊走古城感受當地文化，由早到晚，夜市中的陝西美食，可以找到那些素人之選？榆林的創新融合菜，由擺盤到味道都令人充滿驚喜；最後還會向.

programme.title: 煮題COOK 5
programme.desc: 甜品, 有人視為一頓飯後完美句號; 亦有人任何時候都喜歡來一客甜品獎勵自己。Jacky 出名喜愛甜食; Ricky 則相反最怕吃甜, 要兩人煮出私藏甜食譜, 會得出什廚結果? Jacky 左思右想, 最後選了新加坡地道風味~~馬六甲椰糖西米加斑蘭啫喱.

programme.title: 一個人鐵道行 4
programme.desc: 一下到版納，下火車就被熱帶味包住，像瞬間飛到東南亞；空氣裡是太陽＋香料的味道。先轉去勐泐大佛寺，繞塔求個好彩頭、爬高看整座城；園區還有機甲大象巡遊，走一圈像把佛寺拍成流動的畫。吃一頓有儀式感的『孔雀宴手抓飯』，傣味瞬間拉滿。夜裡就去星光夜市晃一圈，烤.

programme.title: 橫素全中國
programme.desc: 近年聞名全中國的吳堡空心掛麵，究竟如何做到每條麵上有著如針孔般的小孔？今集主持嘉年會去到吳堡石城，認識當地歷史及古老的製麵方式；另外，又會拜訪當地掛麵傳承人，了解由全手工去到今時今日，由工廠機械生產做麵，怎樣保持傳統味道？.

programme.title: 見招拆招風水局之新．裝修佈局
programme.desc: 今集要參觀屋苑位於新界粉嶺，一個385呎單位，以日系和風式裝修，多採用木製傢私，入屋令人有一種山林民宿感覺。但若然太多製傢私，風水玄學上有沒有影響？家中財位被封了，該如何重新佈局？另外「八字喜金人士」適宜用甚麼色彩來佈置居家空間，改善氣場、提升運勢？.
